rule: G7: runtime raw undefined == (BASE pass undefined.stdout - LUA_CPP_IMPORT_DELTA.removed + .added) - raw_removed + raw_added, exactly. P7/P11: final EXACT-IMPORT-IDENTITIES set == final_baseline (207, R15e 53a64553) + final_added, exactly (name, module name/version, library name/version, type). P8: .init_array == expected.init_array and .fini_array == expected.fini_array. A final_added row is admitted only with evidence class captured-provider-export and a provider file whose sha256 still matches; any other class (sdk-stub-only, pending-identity-decode) makes the whole list refuse. The list grows only by such rows, each added with its evidence.
